purpose: Continue the active three-session historical walk-forward goal after Campaign145 without waiting for a new daily bar, while rejecting same-family spectral, lag, field, and model variants before any Campaign146 source or research value is read.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_amount_cross_spectral_phase_lead_59f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Within each fixed half-session, measure the power-weighted signed cross-spectral phase by which demeaned transaction-amount innovations lead demeaned signed close returns over all 59 positive Fourier frequencies, then average the two half-session scores.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: This is a multiscale phase-order statistic over the complete within-half paths. It is not a one-lag Pearson coefficient, unsigned amount-return distribution alignment, fixed-clock timing summary, path-area integral, crossing count, or terminal-factor combination.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_amount_cross_spectral_phase_strength_59f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Discard phase orientation and retain only absolute or squared phase strength.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Removing orientation is a direction-destroying sibling transform of the selected cross-spectrum and would create a post-selection operator search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_amount_low_frequency_phase_lead_10f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Restrict the same phase statistic to an arbitrarily selected low-frequency band.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Frequency-band selection is an exposed tuning degree of freedom; the selected definition uses every positive frequency with no band search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_volume_cross_spectral_phase_lead_59f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Replace transaction amount with share volume in the same cross-spectral construction.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Volume versus amount is an alternate activity-field choice inside one mechanism; transaction amount is selected once before values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_amount_cross_spectral_coherence_59f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Measure unsigned magnitude-squared spectral coherence rather than signed phase lead.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Unsigned coherence is a spectral restatement of contemporaneous dependence and overlaps terminal correlation, volatility-coupling, and distribution-alignment families.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: return_amount_multiband_phase_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.mechanism: Fit frequency weights, phase thresholds, or interactions to historical returns.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: This would open a model and frequency-selection search before establishing one fixed raw-state mechanism.
